create_SparseTensor: create a SparseTensor from features and coordinates tensors for sparse 3D data processing
build_SparseTensor_full: build a full SparseTensor with a given axis-aligned bounding box and feature dimension
test_sparse_cat: test concatenating a list of SparseTensor objects along batch or feature dimension
refactor_SparseTensor_replace: refactor the SparseTensor replace method to update features and coordinates while preserving metadata
summarize_sparse_unbind: summarize how sparse_unbind splits a SparseTensor into a list along a given dimension
